summary: Iteration 293: Checked MODService email delivery with the new Resend key and the supplier badge that shows whether the fault email was delivered. (1) ONE real send: utils.email.send_email(to=TEST_RECIPIENT_EMAIL, subject='MODService email key check', kind='system.ops_alert', category='mod') returned True. The newest email_send_events row for that recipient has status='sent', error='' and sender 'Pulse Fitness MOD Service <modservice@modservice.pulsefitness.com>'. No other address was emailed and the key was never printed. The running supervisor backend process also has RESEND_API_KEY in its environment; it is not in backend/.env, it comes from the shared secret. (2) GET https://api.resend.com/domains returned 200 and lists modservice.pulsefitness.com as verified (also pulsefitness.ai and the support, bookings, memberships and service subdomains). (3) Badge UI with TEST_ data seeded directly in the DB (no emails), 4 cases per org, tested on /pulse (LiteFaultsTab, pulse_pro org) and /dashboard (FaultsTab, gym org) at 1920 and 390. delivered_to=['inda@example.test'] shows the green 'Sent to Inda Fitness'. delivered_to=[] shows the amber 'Email to Inda Fitness not delivered', with a tooltip naming inda@example.test and 'Master Admin → Email log'. Field absent (legacy) shows green. delivered_to=['someone@else.test'] shows amber. Only one badge renders per card, the 'View supplier card' link is present in all 16 checks, and there is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= innerWidth; cards end at x=374 at 390px). (4) Regression: the title 'Technogym SKILLMILL', the S/N line 'Self-Powered Treadmill · S/N DJK04D22000131' and the meta line 'Treadmill | Inda | date' all render. Node unit tests pass (612/0 and 9/0). pytest test_fault_title_and_mod_email_fix.py: 16/16 passed (every send in it is mocked). /api/health returns 200.

issues: Low contrast in the light theme: the amber badge text (text-amber-400, rgb(251,191,36)) on bg-amber-500/20 over white is about 1.7:1, and the existing green 'Sent to' badge (emerald-400) has the same problem. Consider amber-700 / emerald-700 text in the light theme.
Already there before this change: the org name 'TEST_ UI293 gym' wraps onto 3 lines in the black top bar next to the logo.

action_items: Optional: improve the contrast of the amber and green supplier badges in the light theme
critical_code_review_comments: supplierEmailDelivered compares case-insensitively and treats a missing or non-array field as delivered, which is the intended behaviour for older faults. It falls back to auto_dispatched_supplier_email when supplier_case.supplier_email is missing. Fine.
If the supplier has no email at all, supplierEmailDelivered returns true, so the card shows green 'Sent to' even though nothing was sent. This is an edge case; consider a neutral badge.
seed_data_creation: _seed_supplier_badge_ui_293.py seed|clean creates TEST_ui293_pro (pulse_pro) and TEST_ui293_gym (gym), each with 1 equipment item, 4 issues (_i_ok, _i_bad, _i_legacy, _i_other) and 4 supplier_cases. Login is test_ui293_<pro|gym>@example.test / TestUiFault#2026. Cleaned by id; 0 left. 1 email_send_events row ('sent') remains from the single permitted real send.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The real-email check script _email_key_check_293.py only sends when run with --send; without it, it only checks the domains. Do not re-run --send unless asked. UI: log in through the API with the X-RateLimit-Bypass header (RATE_LIMIT_BYPASS_SECRET), set localStorage 'token', then open /pulse?tab=faults or /dashboard and click mobile-pill-issues / tab-issues.
